SELECT 'store' AS k, CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) b, store_name c, city d, region e, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) f, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) g, CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) h FROM dim_store WHERE lower(store_name) LIKE '%nokia%' OR lower(city) LIKE '%nokia%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cal', fiscal_year, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR), fiscal_period_label, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(weeks_in_period AS VARCHAR), CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR), NULL FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 5 AND fiscal_year >= 'FY2025/26'

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE st.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
),
r AS (
  SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) rq, count(*) rn
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id = 118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
),
c AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) cu, sum(receipts) cr FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) n, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM s) nd, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM s GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dupkeys,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM s) qty, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM s WHERE category='ZZ Test') qty_test, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM s WHERE staff_purchase_flag) qty_staff,
 r.rq, r.rn, c.cu, c.cr FROM r, c

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory = cp.subcategory THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_same_label_as_was
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE st.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 8
